item.text: {"analysis":"The bias-free model succeeded, completing 25 epochs with best epoch 5. Validation HR@10 was 0.645, NDCG@10 was 0.4017664123756029, and HR@20 was 0.765. Training and candidate scoring both use embedding dot products, consistent with the frozen host contract. No comparison establishes a ranking improvement from removing biases.","code_summary":"Causal NextItNet with maximum sequence length 128, 64-dimensional tied item embeddings, and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block has two kernel-3 causal convolutions, pre-layer normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, and learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1. Padding is masked after each block and final normalization. Candidate scoring uses the last valid sequence position. No item bias parameters. LR=0.001, weight decay=0, batch size=128."}
